body.name: executable SA-CS-ID transition system
body.construction:
Initialize, for every \(s\in H\), the labelled context kernel
\[
 K_s(v)=\frac{p_H(v,s)}{\sum_{v':(v',s)\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^+)}p_H(v',s)},
\]
the retained constraint list from \(\mathcal I_H\), and the unfinished root task. Apply \(\operatorname{Comp}_H\) to obtain the initial agenda. At each nonterminal state rerun \(\operatorname{Comp}_H\) after the preceding successor has been formed, and apply the unique case selected by \(\mathfrak P_H\): a selector correction if an actual supported-context gate occurrence remains; otherwise removal of the nonempty nonancestor set; otherwise proper-district splitting; otherwise the canonically least reachable fixing whose ledger certificate is produced by the recursive positive-expression construction; otherwise residual compilation. The selected transition is admitted only after its finite graphical eligibility test, exact cross-multiplied polynomial identity, and every required positivity-ledger identity have succeeded. The successor must have smaller \(\mu_H\). The residual relation is the only halting relation and emits either a verifier-accepted rational circuit with its complete denominator domain or a verifier-accepted global-twin box. The compiler depends only on the current normalized state and the fixed input order; neither a published derivation nor a successful agenda is an input.
